title: Pads sound as in Apricity: matched level, A440 detune, root key, warp or no warp
description:
As a beatmaker, I want every pad in the rack to sound as it does in Apricity (same level, in tune, in time), so that a pattern sounds the same on the rack as in the score.

```gherkin
Feature: Pads sound as they do in Apricity
  Background:
    Given a sample "brk.wav" of 2 bars in 4/4 at 100 BPM, tuned 30 cents sharp, analyzed
    And one-shot samples "k.wav" and "s.wav" from the folder "kitA", analyzed
    And the score "flip.apr" at tempo 120 with "kit b = slice brk by beats 1" and a drum kit "drums" of "k.wav" and "s.wav"

  Scenario: Each pad's volume is the level Apricity matched it to
    When I export kit "drums" from "flip.apr"
    Then each pad's sampler volume equals the level group gain "apricity explain flip.apr" prints for "kitA", within 0.1 dB

  Scenario: Pads are detuned to A440 the way Apricity detunes them
    When I export kit "b" from "flip.apr"
    Then every pad of "b" is detuned by -30 cents

  Scenario: Slices of a sample with a beat grid are warped to the score's tempo
    When I export kit "b" from "flip.apr"
    Then every pad of "b" is warped
    And pad 1 carries the warp markers of "brk.wav" that fall inside its slice

  Scenario: A sample with no beat grid plays unwarped
    Given the sample "s.wav" has no beat grid
    When I export kit "drums" from "flip.apr"
    Then pad "snare" is not warped

  Scenario: The sampler's root key is the slice's root, and the pad plays it untransposed
    Given the clip "brk" says "root F"
    When I export kit "b" from "flip.apr"
    Then every pad of "b" has root key F and transpose 0

  Scenario: A note-length pad stops when the note ends
    When I export kit "b" from "flip.apr"
    Then every sampler plays in classic mode with its loop off
```
